audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Peter text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for diaspora/exile, living hope, tested trust, prophets, holiness, imperishable seed.

verses.restored: Peter, apostle of Jesus Messiah, to chosen sojourners of dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

familiar.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

modern.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen

original.text: Πέτρος ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκλεκτοῖς παρεπιδήμοις διασπορᾶς Πόντου, Γαλατίας, Καππαδοκίας, Ἀσίας, καὶ Βιθυνίας,

verses.restored: according to foreknowledge of Divine Father, in sanctification of Spirit, into obedience and sprinkling of blood of Jesus Messiah: grace to you and peace be multiplied.

familiar.text: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

modern.text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance. A Living Hope

original.text: κατὰ πρόγνωσιν θεοῦ πατρός, ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος, εἰς ὑπακοὴν καὶ ῥαντισμὸν αἵματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη.

verses.restored: Blessed be the Divine and Father of our Lord Jesus Messiah, who according to his great mercy gave us new birth into living hope through resurrection of Jesus Messiah from dead ones,

familiar.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

modern.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

original.text: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ κατὰ τὸ πολὺ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἀναγεννήσας ἡμᾶς εἰς ἐλπίδα ζῶσαν διʼ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκ νεκρῶν,

verses.restored: into an inheritance incorruptible and undefiled and unfading, kept in heavens for you,

familiar.text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

modern.text: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,

original.text: εἰς κληρονομίαν ἄφθαρτον καὶ ἀμίαντον καὶ ἀμάραντον, τετηρημένην ἐν οὐρανοῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς

verses.restored: who by power of Divine are guarded through trust into salvation/healing ready to be unveiled in last season.

familiar.text: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

modern.text: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

original.text: τοὺς ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ φρουρουμένους διὰ πίστεως εἰς σωτηρίαν ἑτοίμην ἀποκαλυφθῆναι ἐν καιρῷ ἐσχάτῳ.

verses.restored: In this you rejoice, though now for a little, if necessary, being grieved in various tests/trials,

familiar.text: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

modern.text: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials

original.text: ἐν ᾧ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὀλίγον ἄρτι εἰ ⸀δέον ⸀λυπηθέντες ἐν ποικίλοις πειρασμοῖς,

verses.restored: so that the tested genuineness of your trust, more precious than gold that perishes though tested by fire, may be found into praise and glory and honor at unveiling of Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

modern.text: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

original.text: ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως ⸀πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου διὰ πυρὸς δὲ δοκιμαζομένου εὑρεθῇ εἰς ἔπαινον καὶ ⸂δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν⸃ ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: Whom not having seen, you love; in whom now not seeing yet trusting, you rejoice with joy unspeakable and glorified,

familiar.text: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

modern.text: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

original.text: ὃν οὐκ ⸀ἰδόντες ἀγαπᾶτε, εἰς ὃν ἄρτι μὴ ὁρῶντες πιστεύοντες δὲ ⸀ἀγαλλιᾶσθε χαρᾷ ἀνεκλαλήτῳ καὶ δεδοξασμένῃ,

verses.restored: receiving the outcome of your trust, salvation/healing of souls/lives.

familiar.text: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

modern.text: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

original.text: κομιζόμενοι τὸ τέλος τῆς πίστεως ⸀ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν ψυχῶν.

verses.restored: Concerning this salvation/healing, prophets sought and searched carefully, those prophesying about the grace toward you,

familiar.text: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

modern.text: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,

original.text: Περὶ ἧς σωτηρίας ἐξεζήτησαν καὶ ἐξηραύνησαν προφῆται οἱ περὶ τῆς εἰς ὑμᾶς χάριτος προφητεύσαντες,

verses.restored: searching into what person or what season the Spirit of Messiah in them was making clear, testifying beforehand the sufferings into Messiah and the glories after these.

familiar.text: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

modern.text: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.

original.text: ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρὸν ἐδήλου τὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν παθήματα καὶ τὰς μετὰ ταῦτα δόξας·

verses.restored: To them it was unveiled that not to themselves but to you they were serving these things, now announced through those bringing good news to you by holy Spirit sent from heaven, things into which messengers long to look.

familiar.text: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

modern.text: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things. A Call to Holiness (Hebrews 12:14–17)

original.text: οἷς ἀπεκαλύφθη ὅτι οὐχ ἑαυτοῖς ὑμῖν δὲ διηκόνουν αὐτά, ἃ νῦν ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν διὰ τῶν εὐαγγελισαμένων ⸀ὑμᾶς πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ἀποσταλέντι ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ, εἰς ἃ ἐπιθυμοῦσιν ἄγγελοι παρακύψαι.

verses.restored: Therefore, girding up the loins of your mind, being sober, hope completely upon the grace being brought to you at unveiling of Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

modern.text: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

original.text: Διὸ ἀναζωσάμενοι τὰς ὀσφύας τῆς διανοίας ὑμῶν, νήφοντες τελείως, ἐλπίσατε ἐπὶ τὴν φερομένην ὑμῖν χάριν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: As children of obedience, not being conformed to the former desires in your ignorance,

familiar.text: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

modern.text: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.

original.text: ὡς τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, μὴ συσχηματιζόμενοι ταῖς πρότερον ἐν τῇ ἀγνοίᾳ ὑμῶν ἐπιθυμίαις,

verses.restored: but according to the Holy One who called you, become holy yourselves in all conduct,

familiar.text: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

modern.text: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,

original.text: ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸν καλέσαντα ὑμᾶς ἅγιον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἅγιοι ἐν πάσῃ ἀναστροφῇ γενήθητε,

verses.restored: because it is written: You shall be holy, because I am holy.

familiar.text: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

modern.text: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”

original.text: διότι γέγραπται ⸀ὅτι Ἅγιοι ⸀ἔσεσθε, ὅτι ἐγὼ ⸀ἅγιος.

verses.restored: And if you call upon Father the One judging impartially according to each one's work, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during the time of your sojourn,

familiar.text: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

modern.text: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.

original.text: Καὶ εἰ πατέρα ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸν ἀπροσωπολήμπτως κρίνοντα κατὰ τὸ ἑκάστου ἔργον, ἐν φόβῳ τὸν τῆς παροικίας ὑμῶν χρόνον ἀναστράφητε·

verses.restored: knowing that you were released not by perishable things, silver or gold, from your futile ancestral conduct,

familiar.text: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

modern.text: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,

original.text: εἰδότες ὅτι οὐ φθαρτοῖς, ἀργυρίῳ ἢ χρυσίῳ, ἐλυτρώθητε ἐκ τῆς ματαίας ὑμῶν ἀναστροφῆς πατροπαραδότου,

verses.restored: but by precious blood as of lamb unblemished and spotless, Messiah,

familiar.text: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

modern.text: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.

original.text: ἀλλὰ τιμίῳ αἵματι ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου καὶ ἀσπίλου Χριστοῦ,

verses.restored: foreknown before foundation of world, but made manifest at last of the times because of you,

familiar.text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

modern.text: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.

original.text: προεγνωσμένου μὲν πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, φανερωθέντος δὲ ἐπʼ ⸀ἐσχάτου τῶν χρόνων διʼ ὑμᾶς

verses.restored: who through him trust in Divine, the One raising him from dead ones and giving him glory, so that your trust and hope are into Divine.

familiar.text: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

modern.text: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God. The Enduring Word (Isaiah 40:6–8)

original.text: τοὺς διʼ αὐτοῦ ⸀πιστοὺς εἰς θεὸν τὸν ἐγείραντα αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ δόξαν αὐτῷ δόντα, ὥστε τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐλπίδα εἶναι εἰς θεόν.

verses.restored: Having purified your souls/lives in obedience to truth into unhypocritical sibling-love, love one another earnestly from heart,

familiar.text: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

modern.text: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.

original.text: Τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἡγνικότες ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ⸀ἀληθείας εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον ⸀ἐκ καρδίας ἀλλήλους ἀγαπήσατε ἐκτενῶς,

verses.restored: having been born anew not from perishable seed but imperishable, through living and remaining word of Divine.

familiar.text: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

modern.text: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

original.text: ἀναγεγεννημένοι οὐκ ἐκ σπορᾶς φθαρτῆς ἀλλὰ ἀφθάρτου, διὰ λόγου ζῶντος θεοῦ καὶ ⸀μένοντος·

verses.restored: For all flesh is like grass and all its glory like flower of grass; the grass withered and the flower fell,

familiar.text: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

modern.text: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

original.text: διότι πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς χόρτος, καὶ πᾶσα δόξα ⸀αὐτῆς ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου· ἐξηράνθη ὁ χόρτος, καὶ τὸ ⸀ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν·

verses.restored: but the word of Lord remains into the age. And this is the word good-newsed to you.

familiar.text: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

modern.text: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.

original.text: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν εἰς ὑμᾶς.

translation_notes: Diaspora/sojourner identity is preserved; it is not anti-Jewish but uses exile imagery for the addressed communities.
Suffering/testing is acknowledged without being glorified as an end in itself.
Hope, holiness, and sibling-love are the chapter's ethical center.
